environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) running user-service pod in namespace 'backend'. Pod uses Istio sidecar for mTLS but the gRPC port 50051 is also exposed via a ClusterIP service accessible from any pod in the cluster. Database credentials are stored in a Kubernetes Secret mounted as a volume, rotated every 24 hours via external-secrets-operator syncing from AWS Secrets Manager. NetworkPolicy allows ingress from any pod with label 'mesh-peer=true'. Any compromised pod in the mesh can send arbitrary GraphQL queries including malicious filter strings.
